documents.t: From the Requests page, you can access your sharing card and personal DM request link. Tap the Share button to share it directly to X (Twitter), Bluesky, WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. Anyone who visits your link can send you a DM request — even without a JustCollabs account. Your public profile is also available at justcollabs.com/{nickname}.
documents.s: How do I share my DM request link?

documents.t: DM requests are how creators connect on JustCollabs. Instead of open messaging, you send a request that the other person can accept or decline. This keeps conversations consensual and spam-free.
documents.s: What are DM Requests?

documents.t: To send a request, visit a creator's profile and tap Send DM Request. You'll need to: Verify your identity with Twitter (X) or Bluesky Write a message introducing yourself (up to 1,000 characters) Share your location (country and city) You don't need a JustCollabs account to send a DM request — you can send one as a guest from any creator's public profile at justcollabs.com/{nickname}.
documents.s: Sending a DM Request

documents.t: Incoming requests appear in your Requests tab (bottom navigation). For each request you can see the sender's social media handles, follower count, location, and message. You can accept, ignore, or reject each request. Once accepted, you can both chat freely through the Messages tab.
documents.s: Receiving DM Requests

documents.t: You can control how you're notified about new DM requests in Settings > Notifications — choose to receive email notifications for all requests, only from verified creators, or none at all.
documents.s: Notification Settings

documents.t: Yes, you can join JustCollabs even if you're relatively new. The key requirement is that you consistently publish content on social media — this shows us you're serious about adult content creation. As long as you are of legal age and can demonstrate an active presence on platforms like Twitter (X) or Bluesky, you are welcome to join and start building your network.
documents.s: Can I join if I'm new to content creation?

documents.t: DM requests are how you connect with other creators on JustCollabs. They ensure both parties agree to chat before any conversation starts.
documents.s: How do DM requests work?

documents.t: Send a DM request to a creator you'd like to connect with — include a short introduction message and verify your identity with Twitter (X) or Bluesky The creator reviews your request in their Requests tab and decides whether to accept or decline If accepted, you can both chat freely through the Messages tab
documents.s: How It Works

documents.t: Only verified users can send DM requests. Unverified users cannot initiate DM requests, but they can receive and accept them. If a verified user reaches out to you first, you can chat with them regardless of your verification status.
documents.s: Who Can Send DM Requests?

documents.t: Yes — you can send a DM request as a guest by visiting a creator's public profile at justcollabs.com/{nickname}. You'll need to verify your identity with Twitter or Bluesky. If the creator accepts, you'll be prompted to create an account to start chatting.
documents.s: Can I Send DM Requests Without an Account?

documents.t: When you first sign up, you'll be guided through a multi-step onboarding flow that walks you through the essentials. After onboarding, you can fine-tune everything from your profile settings.
documents.s: How do I set up my profile?

documents.t: The onboarding flow covers the basics: Nickname: Your stage name or alias Date of birth: Age verification (must be 18+) Gender & location: Your gender and home base city Roles: What you do (performer, photographer, director, etc.) Profile photo & bio: Upload a photo using the crop tool and write your bio Social links: Connect Twitter (X) or Bluesky and add your content platform URL
documents.s: During Onboarding

documents.t: You can update and expand your profile anytime from Settings > Profile. Here you can: Update your avatar using the built-in crop tool Edit your bio and personal details Add or change your content platform URLs (OnlyFans, Fansly, etc.) Update social media links (Twitter/X, Bluesky) Fill in performer details if applicable (experience level, preferences, physical attributes) Set your home base city for location-based discovery
documents.s: After Onboarding

documents.t: Settings > Trips: Add travel plans to show where you'll be visiting Settings > Preferences: Adjust your discovery and notification preferences Settings > Account: Update your email or password A complete and accurate profile increases your chances of getting verified and finding suitable collaborators.
documents.s: Other Settings

documents.t: Go to app.justcollabs.com/signup Enter your email address and create a password Complete the CAPTCHA verification Check your email for a confirmation link Click the link to activate your account and begin onboarding Once you're in, the onboarding flow will walk you through setting up your profile step by step. Need help with registration? Contact our support team.
documents.s: How do I sign up?

documents.t: You can apply for verification directly through the app from your Settings page. If your profile is missing anything required, the app will tell you exactly what you need to complete before you can apply. Once you submit your application, our team reviews it manually. Verifications are processed in the order they are received, so please be patient — it may take a few days. If approved, your profile will be marked as verified and you'll gain full access to browse the Performers and Roles pages, use travel plans, and access all platform features. If denied, you'll be notified with a reason and can re-apply after updating your profile.
documents.s: How does the verification process work?

documents.t: Yes — and if you get verified today, it's free forever. All features on JustCollabs are completely free to use for verified members. In the future, we may introduce optional premium services for new users, but anyone who is verified during the current early access period will never be charged or have to pay anything for using JustCollabs. This is our way of saying thank you for supporting the platform early on.
documents.s: Is it free to use?

documents.t: While our platform is optimized for adult creators, we also welcome: Producers/Directors Camera Operators Editors Social Media Managers Accountant/Finance Legal Advisors Stylists, makeup artists, hairstylists Set designers
documents.s: Is JustCollabs only for adult content creators?

documents.t: While getting verified unlocks the full JustCollabs experience, you can still do quite a bit while you wait.
documents.s: What can I do before verification?

documents.t: Complete your profile — Edit your bio, photos, roles, social links, and performer details in Settings > Profile Browse your city's performers — You can see creators in your home city on the Performers page, though some details (age, gender, location, roles) will be blurred Appear in search results — Other users can find you if they toggle the "Not Verified" or "All" filter on the Performers page Receive DM requests — Other users can send you DM requests, and you can accept or decline them Chat with connected users — Once a DM request is accepted (by either side), you can chat freely and see each other's full profile Apply for verification — Submit your verification application from Settings once your profile is complete
documents.s: What You CAN Do

documents.t: Send DM requests — Only verified users can initiate DM requests Browse other cities — You're locked to your home city; you can't change the location or expand the search radius Use advanced filters — Filters like body type, height, weight, etc. are only available to verified users Use travel plans — Creating and managing travel plans requires verification
documents.s: What You CANNOT Do

documents.t: When viewing another creator's profile as an unverified user, you'll see blurred placeholders for their age, gender, location, additional roles, and travel plans. Their bio is also truncated. This restriction is lifted once you get verified — or if you have an accepted DM request with that person.
documents.s: What's Blurred?

documents.t: We prefer profile pictures to be SFW (safe for work). For NSFW content, you have two options: Bluesky gallery — Link your Bluesky account and any NSFW images you post there will automatically appear as a photo gallery on your profile. External links — Add links to your content platforms (OnlyFans, Fansly, etc.) in your profile so visitors can find your work. We do not host adult media directly on JustCollabs.
documents.s: What kind of content can I upload or link to?

documents.t: JustCollabs is a professional networking platform designed specifically for adult content creators to safely connect, collaborate, and grow their businesses through verified profiles and location-based matching.
documents.s: What is JustCollabs?

documents.t: Primarily for established adult content creators (OnlyFans, Fansly, etc.), but also for any industry professionals working in the adult content space such as: Producers/Directors Camera Operators Editors Social Media Managers Accountant/Finance Legal Advisors Stylists, makeup artists, hairstylists Set designers
documents.s: Who is JustCollabs for?

documents.t: When you first sign up for JustCollabs, you'll be guided through a multi-step onboarding flow that helps you set up your profile and get discovered by other creators.
documents.s: How does onboarding work?

documents.t: Enter your nickname (stage name or alias) Set your date of birth (you must be of legal age in the jurisdiction you live in) Choose your gender Select your home base city and country
documents.s: Step 1: Basics

documents.t: Select your roles on the platform (Performer, Photographer, Director, Editor, etc.) If you're a performer, you can fill in additional details like preferences and physical attributes
documents.s: Step 2: Collaboration & Roles

documents.t: Upload a profile photo (SFW only) using the built-in crop tool Write a short bio to introduce yourself and describe what you're looking for
documents.s: Step 3: Profile Photo & Bio

documents.t: Link your Twitter (X) or Bluesky account Add your content platform URL (OnlyFans, Fansly, etc.) These links help with verification and let others learn more about your work
documents.s: Step 4: Social Connect

documents.t: Once onboarding is complete, you can always update your profile information from Settings > Profile. You'll also want to: Apply for verification to unlock full discovery features Add travel plans in Settings > Trips to show where you'll be Browse the Performers page to discover other creators (once verified) The onboarding process takes just a few minutes and ensures your profile has everything it needs to attract the right collaborators.
documents.s: After Onboarding

documents.t: If you've linked your Bluesky account, your profile displays a photo gallery showcasing your latest images from Bluesky. This is the best way to show off your work — including NSFW content — directly on your JustCollabs profile. Any images you post to Bluesky will automatically appear in your gallery.
documents.s: How does the photo gallery work?

documents.t: The gallery pulls up to 10 recent images from your Bluesky posts. It only includes original posts with images — reposts and replies are excluded. Images are displayed in a responsive grid.
documents.s: What does the gallery show?

documents.t: Tap any image to open it in a full-screen lightbox viewer. From there you can: Swipe or use arrow buttons to navigate between images Zoom in for a closer look Press Escape or tap outside the image to close
documents.s: Lightbox Viewer

documents.t: Go to Settings > Profile and link your Bluesky handle. Once connected, the gallery will appear automatically on your profile.
documents.s: How do I connect my Bluesky account?

documents.t: Yes, you can prevent specific users from seeing your profile and interacting with you by blocking them. How it Works: When you block another user: They will no longer be able to view your profile. You will no longer see their profile in discovery or be able to view theirs. Any existing messages between you and the blocked user will be deleted. They will not be able to send you any new messages. Managing Blocks: You can see a list of users you've blocked in Settings > Blocked and can choose to unblock them if you wish. This feature gives you control over who can access your profile and interact with you on JustCollabs.
documents.s: Can I hide my profile from certain users?

documents.t: Starting a collaboration on JustCollabs is straightforward: Browse & Discover (Verified Users): If you're verified, use the Performers page or Roles page (both accessible from the bottom navigation bar) to find creators who match your interests. You can filter by location, specific attributes, and more. Review Profiles: Tap on a creator's card to view their full profile. Check out their bio, linked platforms, Bluesky gallery, travel plans, and collaboration preferences. Initiate Contact: If you're both verified: You can directly send them a chat message to start a conversation. If either of you isn't verified yet: You'll need to send a DM request first. This involves: Writing a message introducing yourself (up to 1000 characters) Verifying your identity by connecting your Twitter (X) or Bluesky account Optionally sharing your location The other person will receive your request in their Requests tab and can choose to accept or decline it. If they accept, you'll both be able to view each other's full profiles and chat freely. Chat & Plan: Once you have chat access (via the Messages tab in the bottom navigation), you can discuss collaboration details — concepts, dates, locations, compensation (if applicable), and any other important specifics. Connect: You can also send a connection request to build your professional network on the platform. Manage your connections in Settings > Connections. This approach keeps things simple while ensuring that all interactions are consensual and professional.
documents.s: How do collaborations get started on the platform?

documents.t: Connections on JustCollabs let you build a professional network of creators and industry professionals you've worked with or want to collaborate with.
documents.s: How do connections work?

documents.t: Visit a creator's profile from the Performers or Roles page Tap the Connect button on their profile Your request is sent to the other person for review
documents.s: Sending a connection request

documents.t: Go to Settings > Connections to see your pending requests Review incoming requests Accept to add them to your network, or Reject to decline
documents.s: Receiving connection requests

documents.t: All your connections are managed in Settings > Connections, where you can: View all your current connections See pending requests (sent and received) Remove existing connections
documents.s: Managing your connections

documents.t: Show that you're an active member of the community Help build your professional reputation Your connection count is visible on your profile Connected users can message each other directly
documents.s: What connections do

documents.t: Be genuine: Connect with people you've actually worked with or want to collaborate with Complete your profile: A thorough profile makes others more likely to accept your request Be professional: Write a thoughtful message when reaching out Stay active: Regularly check your connection requests in Settings
documents.s: Tips for building connections

documents.t: JustCollabs uses location to help you find creators near you or in places you plan to visit. Here's how it works: Set Your Home Base: In Settings > Profile, you set your main home base city. This is your default location for discovery. Your GPS location is never shared — we value your privacy and safety. Add Travel Plans (Optional): In Settings > Trips, you can add specific cities and dates for upcoming trips. Discover Creators: On the Performers page (accessible from the bottom navigation bar), you can: Browse creators who are based in your home city Search for creators in any city using the location picker See who else will be traveling to the same city at the same time as you Use the location picker to search for a custom city Auto-Location: The Performers page can automatically show creators in your current area based on your home base and active trips. This helps you find potential collaborators nearby or in places you'll be visiting.
documents.s: How does the location-based discovery work?

documents.t: Some tips will help make your profile stand out: Use a clear profile photo (use the built-in crop tool in Settings > Profile to get the perfect frame), write a short but engaging bio, and link to your top platforms. Mention your content style, collaboration interests, and availability. If you are a performer, make sure to fill in as many details as possible from your performer profile. Connect your Bluesky account to showcase your work — your Bluesky gallery will be displayed directly on your profile page. Add your content platform URLs so visitors can easily find your work.
documents.s: How can I make my profile stand out?

documents.t: We prefer profile pictures to be SFW (safe for work). For NSFW content, you have two options: Bluesky gallery — Link your Bluesky account and any NSFW images you post there will automatically appear as a photo gallery on your profile. External links — Add links to your content platforms (OnlyFans, Fansly, etc.) in your profile so visitors can find your work. We do not host adult media directly on JustCollabs.
documents.s: Can I showcase NSFW content?

documents.t: Send them a DM request from their profile. Once they accept, you can both chat freely through the Messages tab. That's it! For more details on DM requests, see How DM Requests Work.
documents.s: How do I start chatting with someone?

documents.t: Travel plans help you connect with creators in different locations: How They Work: You can add travel plans in Settings > Trips. You'll specify the destination (city and country) and your start and end dates for the trip. Who Can See Them: Other Verified Users: Your travel plans are visible to other verified JustCollabs members when they are browsing profiles on the Performers page. In Discovery: If another creator is browsing creators in a city you've listed in your travel plans, your profile will appear in their results, indicating you'll be visiting. On Your Profile: Your upcoming travel plans are displayed on your profile page so others can see where you'll be traveling. Contextual Badges: When others view profiles in a specific city, badges indicate if a user is based in that city, "Visiting now," "Visiting soon," or "visiting during your trip". Auto-Location: The Performers page can automatically factor in your active trips to show you relevant creators in the cities you're traveling to. The purpose of sharing travel plans is to maximize your opportunities to find collaborators in different locations. There isn't a feature to make individual travel plans private; they are designed to be part of the discovery process.
documents.s: How do travel plans work and who can see them?

documents.t: Finding creators in nearby cities is easy with JustCollabs' distance discovery feature! This helps you connect with creators you might be able to meet without traveling far.
documents.s: How do I find creators in nearby cities?

documents.t: Open the Performers page from the bottom navigation bar Select a city using the location picker — choose your home city or any travel destination Browse nearby results — creators in surrounding areas will appear with distance indicators Distance badges show exactly how far each creator is from your selected city
documents.s: How It Works

documents.t: Each creator card shows: Distance badge: Small gray badge showing "25km", "45km", etc. Location info: Their home city or current travel location Travel status: Whether they're based there or visiting
documents.s: Visual Indicators

documents.t: Find creators within driving distance for easy meetups Discover creators in the broader metro area Reduce travel costs by collaborating closer to home Build connections in your geographic region
documents.s: Strategic Benefits

documents.t: The status badges are small colored indicators with an airplane icon that appear in the top-right corner of creator profile cards. They show a creator's current location status relative to the city you're browsing.
documents.s: What do the status badges on profiles mean?

documents.t: Here now — Creator is currently visiting this city Soon — Creator will be visiting this city soon Partial — Creator has partial availability in this city on your dates Away — Creator is currently traveling somewhere else Away — Creator is fully away traveling, limited availability No badge means the creator is at their home base in this city — available for collaboration as usual.
documents.s: Badge Types

documents.t: Yes, absolutely! JustCollabs offers a comprehensive filter system to help you find the right collaborators.
documents.s: Can I search for creators in a specific niche or region?

documents.t: On the Performers page (accessible from the bottom navigation bar), you can select any city using the location picker. This can be your home city, a city you're planning to travel to, or any other city you're interested in.
documents.s: By Region/City

documents.t: Tap the filter icon on the Performers page to open the full-screen filter overlay. You can filter by: Gender — narrow by gender identity Age — set an age range Height — filter by height range (displayed in your preferred unit from Preferences) Weight — filter by weight range (displayed in your preferred unit from Preferences) Body Type — Toned, Average, Large, Muscular, Slim, or Stocky Position — Top, Vers Top, Vers, Vers Bottom, Bottom, or Side (only shown when men are viewing men) Ethnicity — filter by ethnicity Face — Shows face, No face, Masked, Blurred, or Can discuss Experience — Beginner, Intermediate, or Professional Verified — toggle to show only verified creators, only unverified, or all Each filter section can be toggled on or off independently. The results update as you apply filters.
documents.s: By Filters

documents.t: You can enable the global filter to keep your filters applied across all cities as you browse. When disabled, filters reset when you change locations.
documents.s: Global Filter Toggle

documents.t: For industry professionals (photographers, videographers, editors, etc.), use the Roles page from the bottom navigation bar. This page lets you filter by role type and location. These filters allow you to narrow down your search and find creators who match your specific collaboration needs and preferences.
documents.s: Roles Page

documents.t: The distance badge is a small indicator that appears on creator profile cards when you're searching beyond your exact city. It looks like this: 25km
documents.s: What does the distance badge on profiles mean?

documents.t: The badge appears in the top-left corner of profile photos when you've expanded the nearby distance slider beyond your exact city It shows the approximate distance between your selected city and the creator's city It's automatically formatted in your preferred units (km or miles), based on your Preferences setting Creators in your exact selected city don't show a distance badge
documents.s: When You See It

documents.t: Distance is measured city to city (straight line between city centers). A creator showing 45km is based in a city approximately 45km from the city you're currently browsing.
documents.s: How Distance Is Calculated

documents.t: The Roles page is a dedicated discovery section for finding industry professionals who work in the adult content space but aren't necessarily performers. This includes photographers, videographers, directors, editors, social media managers, stylists, and other behind-the-scenes professionals.

documents.t: We take your data protection seriously. Here's how we safeguard your information: Privacy Policy: We have a comprehensive Privacy Policy that details what data we collect, how it's used, and your rights. Security Measures: We use a combination of physical, electronic, and administrative safeguards. This includes storing data on secure servers behind firewalls, using HTTPS/TLS for communications, and encrypting sensitive information. User Control: You are responsible for keeping your password confidential. You should set a different password for each platform that you register to. You can access and update your personal information through your profile settings. Third-Party Services: We use reputable third-party services (e.g., for analytics, email delivery) and ensure they also adhere to data protection standards. Transparency: Our Privacy Policy outlines when and how your data might be shared (e.g., with other users as part of the platform's function, with service providers, or for legal reasons). While we implement robust security, please remember that no internet transmission is 100% secure. Always practice good digital hygiene.
documents.s: How is my data protected?

documents.t: JustCollabs is designed with safety in mind for adult content creators. Key measures include: Mandatory Verification: All users undergo a verification process (email, social media identity, age 18+) to ensure legitimacy before gaining full access. Strict Community Guidelines & Content Policies: We have detailed terms of service that prohibit illegal activities, harassment, non-consensual content, and exploitation. Violations can lead to content removal and account termination. Reporting Mechanisms: Users can report content or users that violate our policies. Technical Safeguards: We implement security measures like HTTPS, and data protection practices. Focus on Professionalism: The platform aims to foster a professional environment for collaboration. While we take significant steps to create a safer space, users need to exercise their own judgment and follow best practices for online interactions and real-world meetups.
documents.s: Is JustCollabs safe for adult content creators?

documents.t: Yes. Go to Settings > Account and request account deletion. You'll need to type "DELETE MY ACCOUNT" to confirm. After requesting deletion, there is a 30-day grace period before your account and all associated data are permanently removed. This is required by law (GDPR) to give you time to change your mind. Important: If you log back in during the 30-day period, the deletion is cancelled and the timer resets. To go through with the deletion, simply don't log in for 30 days after requesting it.

documents.t: While JustCollabs facilitates connections, your safety during in-person meetings is your responsibility. We encourage all users to be cautious and take sensible precautions. Here are some tips we recommend: Get to Know Them Online First: Use the JustCollabs messaging system to chat and get a feel for the person before agreeing to meet. Check their JustCollabs profile thoroughly. Look for the completeness of their profile, and any linked social media or content platforms. Consider a video call before meeting in person. This can help you gauge their professionalism and confirm they are who they say they are. Verify Information (To the Extent Possible): While JustCollabs has a verification process, it's wise to see if their online presence across different platforms is consistent if they've shared those links. Be wary if details don't add up or if they are hesitant to share information that would normally be part of a professional collaboration discussion. Meet in a Public Place First: For an initial meeting, choose a public place where others are around. Avoid going to a private residence or isolated location immediately. Consider this first meeting a "vibe check" or a chance to discuss collaboration details and boundaries in a neutral setting. Inform Someone You Trust: Let a friend, family member, or another trusted contact know your plans: who you are meeting, where you are going, and when you expect to be back. Arrange to check in with them at a set time. Share your live location with them via your phone if possible. Trust Your Instincts: If something feels off or makes you uncomfortable at any point (online or in person), do not proceed with the meeting or collaboration. You are never obligated to go through with something if you have a bad feeling. It's okay to change your mind or leave a situation if you feel unsafe. Discuss Boundaries and Expectations Clearly Beforehand: Before the actual collaboration (especially if it involves content creation), have a clear discussion about consent, boundaries, what will be filmed, how content will be used, compensation (if any), and any other important details. Consider putting key terms in writing (even a simple email summary) so everyone is on the same page. Handle Your Own Transportation: Arrange your own transportation to and from the meeting location so you are not dependent on the other person. Keep Personal Information Private Initially: Don't share overly personal information (like your exact home address) until you've built a level of trust. If You Feel Unsafe, Leave and Report: If a situation becomes uncomfortable or unsafe, remove yourself immediately. Report any inappropriate behavior or safety concerns to JustCollabs through the platform's reporting tools or by emailing admin@justcollabs.com. While JustCollabs aims to connect verified creators, always prioritize your personal safety and make informed decisions when arranging offline collaborations.
documents.s: What safety tips do you recommend for meeting collaborators?

documents.t: Your privacy is important to us. We do not sell your personal information to other platforms. Here's how we handle your data regarding third parties: Operational Service Providers: We work with trusted third-party vendors for essential services like hosting, email delivery, analytics (like Google Analytics), and content moderation. These providers only get the information necessary to perform their functions for JustCollabs and are expected to protect your data. Linked Accounts (Your Choice): If you choose to connect your social media accounts (like X/Twitter or Bluesky) for verification or to display content, or if you add links to your external content platforms, that information is shared as per the functionality of those links. Legal Requirements: We may disclose your information if required by law, to comply with a legal process, or to protect the rights, property, or safety of JustCollabs, our users, or the public. Business Transfers: In the event of a merger or acquisition, your information might be transferred as part of our business assets. We encourage you to review our full Privacy Policy for detailed information. We do not share your JustCollabs profile data with other platforms for their independent marketing purposes.
documents.s: Do you share my information with other platforms?

documents.t: Yes, absolutely. Your safety and comfort are important to us. Blocking Users: If you wish to stop another user from contacting you or seeing your full profile details, you can block them directly from their profile page. When you block someone, any existing messages between you will be deleted. You can manage your blocked users list in Settings > Blocked and can choose to unblock them if you wish. Reporting Users/Content: If you encounter a user or content that violates our community guidelines, or for any other safety concern, you can report them. This can be done from their profile page. Reporting a user will also automatically block them for you. Our team will review all reports and take appropriate action based on our policies. For severe violations like CSAM, you can also contact us directly at admin@justcollabs.com.

documents.t: Your profile's visibility on JustCollabs depends on your verification status, interactions with other users, and the DM request system: Verified Users: Once your profile is verified, it becomes discoverable by other verified users on the Performers and Roles pages. They can see your profile information, including your bio, photos, location, travel plans, and other details you've shared, to help find potential collaborators. Public Profile URL: Your profile is accessible at justcollabs.com/{nickname}. This public page shows a limited view of your profile and allows visitors to send you a DM request. Unverified Users & Discovery: If your profile is not yet verified, or if your verification is pending or denied, your profile will NOT appear on the Performers or Roles pages, so most users won't find you through discovery features. Similarly, you won't be able to browse those pages until you are verified. DM Request Exception (Important!): Even if you're not verified, you can still view profiles of users who have accepted your DM (Direct Message) request, and they can view yours. This works both ways: If you're unverified: You can send DM requests to creators. If they accept, you can both view each other's full profiles and chat. If they're unverified: Someone can send you a DM request. If you accept, you can both view each other's profiles regardless of verification status. This allows meaningful connections to form before verification, while preventing spam and maintaining platform quality. Blocking: You can block any user at any time (managed in Settings > Blocked). If you block someone (or they block you), you will not be able to see each other's profiles or interact, regardless of DM requests or verification status. Age Visibility: You have the option to hide your specific age from being displayed on your profile, even though your birth date is used for age verification. General Public: The platform is designed as a network for its registered members. Full profiles are not visible to the general public or search engines. Summary: Always visible to: Yourself, users who have accepted DM requests with you Visible to verified users (if you're verified): Through the Performers and Roles pages Limited public view: Via your public profile URL (justcollabs.com/{nickname}) Never visible to: Blocked users The goal is to create a trusted environment where creators can connect safely while giving everyone a pathway to make meaningful connections.

documents.t: Yes, JustCollabs has a comprehensive set of platform rules and guidelines that all users must agree to and follow. These are primarily detailed in our Terms of Service, which you agree to when you sign up and use the platform. Here's a summary of the key areas covered: Eligibility: You must be 18 years or older to use JustCollabs. Lawful Use: You must use the platform only for lawful purposes and in accordance with our terms. Prohibited Content & Activities: Our Terms of Service (especially Sections 3, 7, and 10 - "Content Standards") explicitly outline what is strictly forbidden. This includes, but is not limited to: Illegal Activities: Any content or activity that violates federal, state, local, or international law. Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM): Absolutely prohibited. We only allow content featuring consenting adults for consenting adults. Exploitation & Harm to Minors: Strictly forbidden. Prostitution & Sex Trafficking: Using the platform to facilitate these acts is prohibited. Specific Prohibited Content Categories: Our "Content Standards" (Section 10 of the Terms) list many types of content that are not allowed, such as defamatory, obscene, abusive, harassing, violent, or hateful material; content promoting discrimination or violence; depictions of non-consensual acts, extreme violence, or certain specific fetishes; "revenge porn"; and more. We urge you to read this section carefully. Harassment & Stalking: Not tolerated. Spam & Unauthorized Commercial Activity: Sending unsolicited promotional material or engaging in unauthorized sales. Impersonation & Deception. Interfering with the Platform: Using bots, viruses, or attempting to disrupt the service. Violating Intellectual Property or Privacy Rights. Account Responsibility: You are responsible for the activity on your account and for keeping your login information secure. Respectful Communication: This applies to interactions with other users and with the JustCollabs support team. Where to Find Them: You can find the full Terms of Service linked on our website, typically in the footer and during the sign-up process. We strongly encourage all users to read these terms carefully to understand their rights and responsibilities. Failure to comply with these rules and guidelines can result in actions such as content removal, account suspension, or permanent termination of your account, and in some cases, referral to law enforcement. Our goal is to maintain a safe, respectful, and professional environment for all adult content creators.
documents.s: Are there any platform rules or guidelines?

documents.t: If you see content on JustCollabs that you believe violates our platform rules (as outlined in our Terms of Service, especially the Content Standards in Section 10), or if you encounter behavior that makes you uncomfortable, please report it immediately. We take such reports seriously. Here are the ways you can report inappropriate content or conduct: Use In-Platform Reporting Tools: We have features that allow you to report specific users or content directly on the platform. Look for "Report" buttons or options on user profiles or within other relevant areas. When you report, you'll typically be asked to choose a reason (e.g., Spam, Harassment, Inappropriate Content, Impersonation) and provide additional details. Email Us Directly: For any type of inappropriate content, abuse, or violations of our Terms of Service, you can email us at admin@justcollabs.com. For very serious violations like suspected Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM) or content related to Prostitution/Sex Trafficking, it is crucial to email admin@justcollabs.com promptly. When you make a report, please provide as much information as possible, such as: The username of the person or a clear description of the content you are reporting. Where you saw the content (e.g., on a specific profile page, in a message). Why you believe it is inappropriate or violates our rules. The date and time you saw it. Any supporting evidence. We will investigate all reports and take appropriate action in accordance with our policies, which may include content removal, warnings, or account suspension/termination. Your help in reporting such content is vital for maintaining a safe and respectful community.
documents.s: What should I do if I see inappropriate content?

documents.t: Absolutely! We welcome your suggestions for new features and reports of any bugs you might find. Your input is valuable in helping us make JustCollabs better for everyone. Here's how you can share your ideas or report issues: Via the Contact Support Form (if logged in): When you're logged into your JustCollabs account, go to Settings > Support. You can select "Feedback" from the category dropdown to suggest new features or improvements. Select "Bug" to report any technical issues or errors you encounter. Please provide as much detail as possible, including what you were doing when the bug occurred, what you expected to happen, and what actually happened. By Email: You can email your feature requests, general feedback, or detailed bug reports to admin@justcollabs.com. For bug reports, please include: Your username and the email associated with your account. A clear description of the bug. Steps to reproduce the bug, if possible. The type of device and browser you were using. Screenshots, if they help illustrate the problem. While we have a policy regarding unsolicited new product ideas, we are always eager to hear your feedback on our existing platform and how we can improve it. We appreciate you taking the time to help us enhance JustCollabs!
